market_name: Will 6 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the market probability move is confirmed and not a thin-book spike; cross-check 2y/10y yields and Fed funds futures for corroboration.
time_plan.1h: Confirm TLT direction aligns with SOFR/Fed funds futures repricing; look for any Fed speaker or data release explaining the move.
time_plan.2h: Re-assess whether move is macro (data/Fed-driven) vs idiosyncratic market noise; check if equity and USD are consistent with dovish thesis.
time_plan.6h: Evaluate persistence; compare TLT move to intraday range and whether rates market has fully absorbed the signal.
time_plan.12h: Final read: did TLT/rates confirm the dovish leak? Log realized vs expected and note if move reversed.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability of 6 rate cuts in 2026 (150bps of easing) signals markets pricing a much more dovish Fed path than currently embedded. That pulls forward-rate expectations lower, which mechanically lifts long-duration Treasury prices. TLT is the most liquid, high-duration proxy for that repricing. Conversely, if the probability collapses (hawkish repricing), TLT falls.

predictions.tradable_instrument_name: Invesco DB US Dollar Index Bullish Fund

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Verify the probability move is real; check DXY and EUR/USD for immediate confirmation.
time_plan.1h: Compare UUP direction to rate-differential moves; watch for offsetting global risk-off dollar demand.
time_plan.2h: Assess whether dollar weakness is holding or being swamped by safe-haven flows.
time_plan.6h: Re-check consistency with TLT/rates thesis and any macro headlines.
time_plan.12h: Final read on UUP vs expectation; note reversal or weak-proxy failure.

predictions.reasoning: A higher probability of aggressive 2026 Fed easing narrows expected US rate differentials, which is typically dollar-negative. UUP is a liquid DXY proxy. The exposure is weaker and noisier than the rates channel because FX also reflects relative global central-bank paths.

evidence_used: Market question implies pricing of a very dovish 2026 Fed path (6 cuts = ~150bps)
Rate-cut expectations map directly to Treasury duration and USD via rate differentials
TLT and UUP are highly liquid, broadly-traded proxies for rates and the dollar
uncertainty_notes: A 700bps (7%) move threshold is far above what these proxies realistically move in 12h on a rate-path signal; neither prediction is 'tradable' by that bar
The mislabeled 'military_conflict' topic suggests metadata noise; treat category as unreliable
Direction depends entirely on whether the 6-cut probability rose (dovish) or fell (hawkish); the prompt gives no move direction, so I assume a probability increase

llm_justification.summary: This market's implied probability of 6 Fed cuts in 2026 is a direct read on expected US monetary easing. A sharp rise implies a more dovish path than priced, which should push long-duration Treasuries (TLT) up and the dollar (UUP) down via lower forward rates and narrower rate differentials. The rates channel is the cleaner mapping; FX is noisier. Magnitudes are modest and well below the 700bps tradability threshold, so this is research signal only.
key_assumptions: The relevant anomaly is a rise in the probability of aggressive easing (dovish)
Fed rate-path expectations transmit to Treasury and FX prices within the window
No dominant offsetting shock (e.g., risk-off flight to dollar) overrides the rate-differential effect
failure_modes: The information is already public/priced (Fed guidance, data) so no fresh move follows
Probability move reflects a hawkish repricing instead, flipping both directions
Safe-haven dollar demand overwhelms the rate-differential channel, breaking the UUP thesis
Prediction-market move is thin-book noise with no macro content
Magnitude vastly overstated relative to actual 12h volatility—move is real but tiny
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
